All descriptions of products or product pricing are subject to change at any time without notice at our sole discretion. We reserve the right to refuse any order placed with us in case of inaccuracies or suspected fraudulent behavior.
seoDescription: Review our terms and conditions for shopping, delivery, pricing, and warranties.

title: Privacy Policy
content: At VANGUARD BD, we are committed to protecting your privacy and security. We collect customer information such as name, phone number, and delivery address solely for the purpose of order processing, shipping, and fraud prevention. We do not sell or share your personal data with third-party marketers.
seoDescription: Learn how VANGUARD BD collects, protects, and uses customer personal information.

title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
content: We offer express nationwide shipping across all 64 districts in Bangladesh via trusted couriers (Steadfast, Pathao, RedX). Inside Dhaka delivery charge is ৳70 (takes 24-48 hours). Outside Dhaka delivery charge is ৳130 (takes 48-72 hours). Free delivery is available on orders over ৳3,000.
seoDescription: Nationwide shipping delivery times, delivery fees, and cash on delivery instructions.

title: Return & Refund Policy
content: We offer a 7-day easy exchange and return policy. If you receive a damaged product or an incorrect size, please notify our customer helpline within 3 days of delivery. Returns must include original tags, packaging, and unwashed condition.
seoDescription: 7-day easy returns and size exchange guidelines.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Orders inside Dhaka are delivered in 24-48 hours. Outside Dhaka takes 2-4 days.

Q: What are the payment options?
A: We offer Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Bank Transfer.

Q: How can I exchange for a different size?
A: Contact our helpline or WhatsApp within 7 days of receiving your parcel.
seoDescription: Frequently asked questions regarding sizing, shipping, and returns.
